newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks seen mixed to lower, peso stable.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks seen mixed to lower, peso stable.

text.p: Dealers saw stocks opening mixed with a downside bias on Monday in a continuation of profit-taking seen on Friday afternoon, with a possible recovery on second quarter earnings later.
Technical analysts situated support at 4,700 points on the IPC scale, down from Friday's close of 4,722.42.
Traders saw the peso opening stable on firm U.S. 30-year Treasury bonds, which were up 3/32 in early trade to yield 6.45 percent.
Dealers forecast a trading range of 7.7750/7.8050 per dollar for the 48-hour peso. Pre-open bids stood at 7.7790/7.7840 per dollar, compared to Friday's close of 7.7860/7.7890.
Overnight rates on Cetes were seen opening lower from the prior close of 18.50 percent on tighter liquidity due to the stable peso, dealers said.
